other_conditions: Students must belong to Other Eligible Communities (OEC) or Other Equivalent Communities of Kerala.
Students must be studying in Government, Aided, Recognized Un‑Aided, CBSE, ICSE affiliated schools or Kendriya Vidyalayas in Kerala.
Students must be studying in Class 1st to 10th.
benefits_summary: Provides cash assistance of ₹320 for classes I‑IV, ₹630 for classes V‑VII, and ₹940 for classes VIII‑X to eligible pre‑matric students.
